_doc: The 12 macro sub-regions of Valencious (Region 1, world +-6144 m, metres from Ashford, north = -z). Input of tools/world/gen_valencious.py. A region is a set of lobes [x, z, radius]; every ground point belongs to the lobe with the smallest distance/radius (multiplicatively weighted Voronoi, borders domain-warped by 'border_warp' m), then heights/biomes are blended over 'blend_m'. h_min/h_max = target height band (m, WorldGen terms); roughness 0..1 scales the small-scale relief inside the band; ridged 0..1 = share of ridged mountain relief (massifs); biomes = weights over the biome ids below. See docs/world/VALENCIOUS_WORLD.md section 'Macro sub-regions'.

regions.realm_note: Ashford-Kingsreach core, Crownstead, Greenhollow, Mere shore
